name: Whelp nest
description: a crack in the ground: a low flat mound of black basalt rock split by a wide crack that glows bright orange inside like a furnace, rough rock lips around it, smoke rising, a small whelp's claw poking out of the crack

poses.stand: a wide glowing crack in a low flat mound of black rock on the ground
poses.struck: jolted, chips of rock and sparks flying off it, the glow inside flaring
poses.dead: the crack collapsing shut into cold grey rubble

idle.action: the crack pulses with orange light and smoke puffs out of it

hurt.action: is struck, chips of rock and sparks fly off it and the glow inside flares, then it settles

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers

style: Painterly digital painting in the style of dark fantasy video game art: soft visible brush strokes, rich shading, gritty and detailed, warm hellfire rim light, high resolution and smooth (not pixel art, not a cartoon).

prompts.standFromText: Paint {description}. Seen from the side, centered in the frame with lots of empty space around it, the whole thing visible. {style} {background}
prompts.pose: Image 1 is {description}. Show this exact same object, the same design, {action}. Keep its shape, colors, size and position in the frame and the painterly art style of image 1. {background}
